lead: A shape's synthesized class cannot carry a codec, because two different shapes share it.
body: `nvs_ir::lower::shape_class_label` keys on the sorted field *names* alone (`crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/mod.rs:2957`), so `{n: int}` and `{n: string}` are one class and one `ClassDesc` — which is why `nvs_stdlib::json`'s encoder walks a shape's slots by tag instead of reading `desc.codec()` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/json.rs:583`). Anything handing a shape's per-field wire types to a native helper has to carry them at the *call site*, next to the `WRITTEN_CLASS_MEMBERS` descriptor rather than inside it.
